Senses.Explanation: The Brahma king is a pre-Chan figure whom Chan records place before the Buddha as requester or attendant. The stored witnesses invoke him in ceremonial comparisons and in questions about who initiated or witnessed an assembly; none of these headword cases supports calling him the presenter of the flower.
